what: First successful execution of tests/browser-qa.mjs, the rendered-browser accessibility and reflow harness.
priorStatus: Prepared but never run. The 13 October environment could not launch Chromium ("Operation not permitted" on a required Unix socket) and the cloud browser could not reach a loopback preview (ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED).
causeClassification: Browser/runtime infrastructure, not application behaviour and not harness logic.
rootCause: The harness launched chromium with a hardcoded executablePath of /usr/bin/chromium, which is absent on macOS and on a GitHub runner; the one environment that did provide it denied the launch. It now defaults to the Chromium Playwright installs for this package, with CHROMIUM_PATH as an override, and rethrows an actionable error rather than exiting quietly.
adversarialCheck: CHROMIUM_PATH=/nonexistent/chromium exits 1 with an actionable message, so an unavailable browser cannot read as a pass.
limits: Headless Chromium only. No Firefox, no Safari/WebKit.
axe-core covers the machine-decidable subset of WCAG; it is not a conformance result.
No screen reader, no physical device, no printed QR, no OS high-contrast or reduced-motion verification.
Run against the local dist/ over loopback, never against a public deployment.
